rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese verb for the subjunctive of “be”; Cantonese normally uses ordinary 係, often after words such as 希望 or 如果, rather than marking the subjunctive separately.

example.english: If I were you, I wouldn't do that.
example.traditional: 如果我係你，我就唔會咁做。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 hai6 nei5 ngo5 zau6 m4 wui5 gam3 zou6
